name: Zhejiang Fine-Motion Robot Joint Technology
name_zh: 浙江环动机器人关节科技股份有限公司
summary: Zhejiang Fine-Motion Robot Joint Technology, also known as Huandong Technology, manufactures precision reducers for robot joints. Its catalog includes SHPR E-series and C-series cycloidal reducers, with model-specific dimensional drawings and rating tables for reducer selection.
